known_limitations: SAFETY: negative target-lane projected gap ambiguity -- 20-sample targeted geometry audit (Waymax SAT/OBB overlap, ground truth) found 0/20 confirmed physical overlaps; SAFETY_CRITICAL_UNCERTAIN archetype and STOP are excluded from primary K/F/M discriminability and Tier A/B/C eligibility, preserved only as a secondary diagnostic flag.

REAR_PRESSURE is the rarest archetype surviving eligibility filtering (14/149 TRAIN, 9/61 VALIDATION in Tier A+B) -- most REAR_PRESSURE-tagged candidates were genuine non-merge-context scenes (serial_continuation/lane_change), not a sampling artifact.

CLEAR_MERGE_OPPORTUNITY archetype does not appear in Tier A/B for either split -- it is inherently a low-meaningful-action archetype (uncontested merge) that lands in Tier C or INELIGIBLE by construction, not a filtering bug.
Dataset is derived entirely from WOMD logged (not simulated/adversarial) contexts.

This dataset is an action-affordance/discriminability dataset, NOT a ground-truth action label dataset -- decision_relevance/archetype/tier fields describe where KEEP/FOLLOW/MERGE plausibly have state-dependent value, never which action is 'correct'. PPO is expected to learn action selection via reward, not supervised imitation of these fields.

source_front_present (at decision/commit frame) is rare even within Tier A+B (1.46%, 16/1097 TRAIN) -- FOLLOW-vs-KEEP differentiation in the trivial-policy diagnostic sample (n=30) showed 0 candidates with a source-lane lead, so AlwaysFollow was byte-identical to AlwaysKeep in that specific small sample; this is a known schema/sampling sparsity limitation, not evidence that FOLLOW is redundant at full Tier A+B scale (1.46% of 1097 is a real, if thin, non-zero population).

AlwaysMerge diagnostic success rate (50%, n=30, Tier A/B only) is elevated but not judged dominant (brief's own no-fixed-threshold guidance; below this session's 90% dominant-shortcut heuristic) -- reported for transparency, not treated as a frozen baseline result.

This entire dataset-filter freeze (Tier A/B/C, eligibility, canonical manifest) is DISTINCT from and does not modify the older, stricter v2 canonical pipeline (scripts/build_merge_v2_manifest.py / src/scenarios/v2_manifest.py) which still requires calibration_status=='calibrated' and per-candidate manual_validation=='CONFIRMED_MERGE' -- neither holds yet for this new Tier system; manual_validation values were never read or modified by this freeze work.

The diagnostic-only trivial-policy sanity check (scripts/diagnose_merge_v2_trivial_policy_sanity.py) routes ManeuverSpec through MergeEnvironment using schema_version=LEGACY_DATASET_SCHEMA specifically to avoid invoking or weakening ManeuverSpec.require_schema's CONFIRMED_MERGE contract -- this is a narrow, explicitly-scoped diagnostic path, not a new canonical evaluation pipeline, and is not to be used as a final PPO/FSM baseline result.
